asks: Which tools may an extension use?
answer: An extension can use only the tools its manifest names, and installing it grants them. A tool reads, shows, protects or gives an opinion: it reads a path or the record of a computer, shows an alert, a question or a panel in the app, protects by denying, holding or pausing, or gives an opinion about lines of the record it read. Where a tool applies to computers, the user chooses which ones when installing: all of them, or specific ones. Which tools Silo offers is settled when they are built.
